description: Request a short-lived upload grant for ONE image file — step 1 of attaching a photo (any vertical/role). Use it when the user wants a photo on a new listing (then create_listing) or added to an existing one (then update_listing_images) — call it once per image, maximum 6 images per listing. Do not use it when you only have an image URL: it needs the raw file bytes (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB), and it attaches nothing by itself. Returns { key, upload_url, upload_token, headers_required }: PUT the raw image bytes to upload_url with exactly those headers, then pass the returned key in create_listing's `images` array or update_listing_images' `add` array. A key whose bytes were never uploaded fails later with image_not_uploaded. Images are AI-moderated for content safety before the listing goes live. Requires the user to be connected to Teppek (authenticated).

content_type.description: MIME type of the image file. Example: "image/png".

file_size.description: Exact file size in bytes, at most 10485760 (10 MB). Example: 2097152 for a 2 MB file.

name: request_image_upload
